jobs.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title:  Senior DevOps Engineer 
  Location:  USA (Remote or Regional Office) 
  Reports To:  SVP of Engineering 
  About Cyware  
 Cyware delivers an innovative approach to cybersecurity that unifies threat intelligence, automation, threat response, and vulnerability management with data insights gleaned from assets, users, malware, attackers, and vulnerabilities. Cyware’s Cyber Fusion platform integrates SOAR and TIP technology, enabling collaboration across siloed security teams. Cyware is widely deployed by enterprises, government agencies, and MSSPs, and is the leading threat intelligence sharing platform for global ISACs and CERTs. 
  Why We’re Hiring  
 Cyware is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, secure, and operate the infrastructure supporting product environments in AWS and AWS GovCloud. This role owns CI/CD, deployment, and operational reliability across commercial and government environments, ensuring releases meet high standards of security, availability, and compliance across cloud boundaries, including FedRAMP High, GovRAMP Moderate, and IL5 environments. 
  About You  
 
 You are driven, inquisitive, proactive, and energetic. 
 You have a growth mindset and are committed to delivering results. 
 You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 
 You are passionate about cloud engineering, DevOps, automation, security, reliability, and scalable systems. 
 
  Come join an exciting cybersecurity product startup that has closed its Series C funding round!  
  What You’ll Do  
 
 Work closely with development teams to integrate projects into production AWS and AWS GovCloud environments and ensure ongoing support. 
 Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent; support Helm chart packaging and ArgoCD/GitOps deployment into Kubernetes. 
 Operate and harden infrastructure within compliance-heavy authorization boundaries such as FedRAMP High, GovRAMP Moderate, and IL5, maintaining continuous compliance across releases. 
 Own environment segmentation, secrets management, and access controls consistent with NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP control families. 
 Manage Kubernetes workloads, Helm chart versioning, and release promotion across development, staging, commercial, and GovCloud production environments. 
 Build reliable, scalable infrastructure services in AWS and support infrastructure for both cloud and on-premise deployments. 
 Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK for repeatable, auditable provisioning. 
 Support database deployment and schema migration using Postgres, Flyway, or equivalent tooling tied to release cycles. 
 Build monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational automation to meet government-grade availability and incident-response requirements. 
 Partner with Security/GRC to prepare and maintain evidence for FedRAMP/GovRAMP continuous monitoring, POA&Ms, annual assessments, and audit cycles. 
 Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis for GovCloud-hosted environments, with documentation meeting government audit standards. 
 Gain deep application-level knowledge of systems and contribute to their overall design; troubleshoot application, deployment, and operations issues. 
 Build engineering automation and productivity tools to streamline and scale production applications while minimizing manual interaction. 
 Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Security/GRC to keep commercial and government environments aligned with the product roadmap without compliance drift. 
 Be a DevOps champion by building security, reliability, scalability, and best practices into the development lifecycle. 
 
  Who You Are  
 
 US Citizenship is a requirement of this position in accordance with 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(2)(C). 
 5+ years of experience in DevOps/Platform/Site Reliability Engineering, with 2+ years operating workloads in AWS GovCloud.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.  
 Cloud Platform Engineer 
 An overview of this role 
 As a Cloud Platform Engineer on the Runway team, you'll help design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and developer tooling that powers our engineering organization. You'll advance our Kubernetes-based platform, mature our GitOps practices, and expand infrastructure as code adoption across the business. This hands-on role brings together infrastructure, automation, and developer experience, helping application teams deploy and operate their services. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Operate and improve production Kubernetes clusters across cloud environments, managing upgrades, scaling, and reliability throughout the cluster lifecycle. 
 Own and extend Argo CD-based GitOps workflows, maintaining ApplicationSets, managing sync policies, and enforcing deployment standards across environments. 
 Write, review, and maintain reusable Terraform modules, with clear practices for state management and drift detection. 
 Monitor platform health, respond to incidents, conduct post-mortems, and improve availability, performance, and observability. 
 Collaborate with application teams to onboard services, and create documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling that improves developer productivity. 
 Implement role-based access control, network policies, and secrets management to meet infrastructure security and compliance requirements. 
 Integrate platform capabilities with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to support end-to-end delivery workflows. 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 Experience operating Kubernetes in production and working with at least one major cloud provider: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure. 
 Experience with Argo CD or comparable GitOps tooling, such as Flux. 
 Proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning, including remote state, workspaces, and module design. 
 Ability to write scripts and automation in Python, Bash, or Go. 
 Familiarity with Helm for Kubernetes package management. 
 Understanding of networking fundamentals, including the Domain Name System (DNS), load balancing, ingress, and service mesh concepts. 
 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document systems and collaborate across teams. 
 Optional: experience with managed, multi-cluster, or multi-region Kubernetes, service meshes, policy as code, observability, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure as code; open source or platform tooling contributions; or relevant certifications. 
 
 About the team 
 The Runway team builds and maintains infrastructure and developer tooling for GitL

Your role  You'll own the foundation the rest of engineering builds on: how we run in production, how we stay secure and audit-ready, and how we ship. It's a high-ownership role on a small team. You decide what matters most, build it, and make it stick. Hands-on experience operating production SaaS systems on AWS, with a strong grasp of AWS services and cloud architecture.    Infrastructure as code, ideally with Terraform.    A track record of building CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows, and of making developers faster.    Production experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management. You can diagnose issues across infrastructure and application code.    A strong understanding of distributed systems, networking, databases, and cloud security.    Experience implementing security controls and supporting an external audit or certification such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.    Strong programming skills. Nice to have     Experience benchmarking infrastructure options or optimizing cloud costs.    Familiarity with Salesforce or building integrations on top of it.    Time at an early-stage startup where you built the platform, not just ran it.    Your responsibilities     Keep Weflow reliable.  Own monitoring and alerting, improve visibility into production failures, and lead incident response with the engineering team. Fix recurring problems at the root and regularly verify that we can recover from failures.     Own the engineering side of security and compliance.  Improve cloud access controls, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain technical controls, gather evidence for our SOC 2 Type II audits, and drive engineering follow-up on audit findings.     Improve how we build and ship. Why Weflow   Real ownership : You set the direction for our platform from day one. No ticket queue, no layers of approval.   Visible impact:  Every reliability, security, or delivery win shows up directly in what customers experience and how fast we ship.   A team that builds with AI:  We use AI across the stack and want you to push that further in infrastructure.
